title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Pay Reversal Grounds and Window Table
content:
Posted pay on Cartwise Shopper Batches can be taken back only within a reversal window and only on the grounds listed for the batch type; tips are outside reversal on every batch type.

| Batch type | Reversal window (calendar days after completion) | Grounds on which posted pay is reversed | Tips can be reversed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated | No |
| Express 30 Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated; order not delivered (verified) | No |
| Single Delivery Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated; order not delivered (verified) | No |
| Double Delivery Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated; order not delivered (verified) | No |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated; order not delivered (verified) | No |
| Stock-Up Batch | 30 | duplicate pay; fraud substantiated; order not delivered (verified) | No |

## Notes

- The listed grounds are the only grounds on which posted pay is reversed. The Shop-Only Batch has no "order not delivered (verified)" ground.
- Tips move only by the customer's own tip changes and are never reversed.
